_comment: Planted-error corpus (audit repair 4). Fully synthetic: invented person, employers, numbers — nothing derived from real workspace data. Every corrupt_/style_ file is baseline_clean.txt with the single edit described in corruption_note. Judged directly against synthetic_master.txt + synthetic_jd.txt by evals/fixtures.py; never routed through generation.

entries.corruption_note: No corruption. Every claim traceable to the synthetic master. Any hallucination flag on this file is a false positive; per-class catch rates are meaningless without this control.
p95 latency reduction 37% -> 52%; 52% appears nowhere in the master.
Appended an invented $2M savings claim to the EDI bullet; no $2M figure exists in the master.
Meridian Freight Systems -> Northwind Logistics Group; employer absent from the master.
Senior Software Engineer -> Principal Engineer at Meridian; title absent from the master.
Meridian tenure 2021-2025 -> 2019-2025, overlapping the BlueLark years; 2019 appears nowhere in the master.
Added an AWS Solutions Architect certification the master does not list (master has only CKA).

Claims the JD's own '4 billion tracking events per year' as personal achievement; figure exists only in the JD. Provenance is doubly blind here: by policy (the JD is a legitimate source for its own text) and by regex form (spelled-out magnitudes like '4 billion' don't match the claim pattern's k/m/b suffix form) — this fixture measures whether the judge covers it.
First three Meridian bullets rewritten passive and hedged ('was involved in various activities'); all numbers unchanged and traceable.
Skills section replaced with repetitive keyword spam; no new numeric claims introduced.

The Meridian dispatch role is repeated as a standalone SELECTED PROJECTS entry, restating its headline metrics (250,000 lines, 18 services, 99.7% SLA, 120,000 events/day, 37%). No claim is false and every number is traceable to the master -- the fabrication is structural: one body of work presented as two, so a reader counts it twice. Added 2026-08-10 after GD-03 showed all three judges scoring a real resume 5.0 on accuracy across 15 runs while it double-counted a project this way. The deterministic gate cannot see it either (zero violations), because the duplicated numbers are traceable precisely by virtue of being real.
